evidence.excerpt: Surgical workflow assistance is inherently anticipatory: systems must reason about how procedures evolve, not just recognize the current frame.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Experiments on public laparoscopic benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements in phase anticipation, multi-label tool presence prediction, and remaining-time estimation over RGB-based forecasting baselines, while enabling a plug-and-play representation interface for lightweight downstream heads.
